item.title: How Locals and Shopkeepers Tried to Save One Paris Street From Rioters
item.description: As arson, looting and destruction overwhelmed Rue Beaurepaire, some residents pleaded with rioters to stop. Others hid out of fear. Many dread a repeat.

item.title: Iran Braces for More War, No Matter the Outcome of the U.S. and Israeli Elections
item.description: With Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu fighting to stay in power and President Trump facing a tough midterm, Iran’s leaders expect no major shift in policy.

item.title: Liu Yandong, Rare Woman Among China’s Political Elite, Dies at 80
item.description: The former vice premier was one of just six women to have served on the Chinese Communist Party’s elite Politburo, though she was excluded from the top ranks of power.

item.title: Thailand’s Most Famous Snake Catcher
item.description: Pinyo Pukpinyo, Thailand’s most famous snake catcher, has found the critters slithering in nooks and crannies all over Bangkok. He refuses to kill them.

item.title: COP17 Biodiversity Talks in Yerevan, Armenia
item.description: Countries renewed their promises to protect wildlife at U.N. talks in Armenia, but how to cover the costs remains a question.
